card.title: Our First Secret
card.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we pack Mum's biscuit tin, knock twice. That was our first secret.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She knew we emptied it. She told me years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still kept our signal. There's my brother.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You take the tin. We hardly see each other now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then knock twice when you visit. I'll know you're here for our tin, even if it's full.
